scope: Pure bounded Buffer snapshot, actual SHA256/size verification and lossless UTF-8 byte-range chunk descriptors. No filesystem input, network, model, ingestion, extraction, approval, Canonical or Receipt operation.
source_semantics: Reuses existing content_hash/size_bytes metadata names without introducing a service wire schema or verified source ownership. Expected bytes supplied by an untrusted caller are not authenticity evidence.
reviewed_properties: Copies input once so returned text, source hash, chunk hashes and offsets use one stable snapshot.
Fatal UTF-8 decoding rejects malformed input; BOM, Unicode scalars, CRLF and normalization remain unchanged.
Chunks start/end on UTF-8 boundaries, advance monotonically, are contiguous and remain within declared byte/count bounds.
Repeated content retains caller source_ref provenance; no persistent dedup or authenticated provenance claim.
1MiB/65536-byte/4096-chunk limits are local engineering limits; token_count null does not assert any 2048-token Context Pack requirement.

independent_validation.targeted_command: node --input-type=module; independent synthetic Unicode scalar edge cases with nonzero Buffer offset, chunk sizes 4 through 64.
checks: Exact reconstruction across UTF-8 1/2/3/4-byte scalar edges including BOM and embedded NUL.
Every byte offset contiguous and bounded; every returned chunk hash matches the exact original slice.
A subarray with nonzero backing-buffer offset produces only selected source bytes.

next_step: After original Entry/implementation prerequisites, bind an authorized source/storage reference and exact bytes into existing authenticated ingest transaction; test actual ownership, extraction, confirmation and durable evidence chain. This engineering acceptance alone cannot activate that path.
